description: After fz-bin.10 fixes transport shape ownership for fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz, the fixture no longer panics with transport shape anchor disagreement. Current post-transport blockers are: fz2 interp fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz exits with 'backend value 8 is unbound'; fz2 run exits with 'compiler2 root 0 JIT compile failed: codegen: ReturnLanes arity mismatch ... lanes=2, return_reprs=0'; fz2 build -o /tmp/enum_predicate_search_bin exits with the same AOT ReturnLanes arity mismatch. Investigate backend value binding and native return-lane projection for Enum predicate/search callbacks before re-enabling the fixture execution modes.
title: Enum predicate/search execution fails after transport settles
